backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile storage and per-user URL favorites (add/remove/get), with role-based access control via MixinAuthorization and AccessControl mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old actor state (which included a songFavorites map) to new state by dropping songFavorites while preserving userProfiles and favorites.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing completed tasks for removing all music-related frontend pages, components, services, hooks, and data files from the codebase.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and any notable changes made during development.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file importing Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the Kitsch-io React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query and a TanStack Router with three routes: Home (/), Games (/games), and Movies (/movies), all nested under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file — the AddToPlaylistModal component has been removed as part of the music feature cleanup.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a browser game's title, category badge, description, and an external Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/GameModal.tsx: Modal overlay that renders a dynamically provided game component with a header showing the game's title, category, and an Escape/click-outside close handler.
frontend/src/components/games/BreakoutGa: A canvas-based Breakout game with paddle, ball, and colored brick grid, supporting mouse control, lives, scoring, and win/loss states.
frontend/src/components/games/MemoryMatc: A React memory card matching game using music emoji pairs, tracking moves and detecting a win when all pairs are matched.
frontend/src/components/games/Platformer: A canvas-based side-scrolling platformer where the player jumps between platforms to collect stars, with keyboard controls and a win condition.
A canvas-based Snake game with grid rendering, keyboard direction controls, food collection scoring, and game-over detection on wall or self collision.
frontend/src/components/games/TicTacToeG: A two-player Tic-Tac-Toe React component with a 3x3 grid, win/draw detection, and a reset button.
frontend/src/components/games/WordleGame: A music-themed Wordle clone where players guess a 5-letter word in 6 attempts, with color-coded feedback and keyboard input support.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app shell providing a fixed background texture layer, dark overlay, header with Home/Games/Movies navigation links, a Style button for the personalization panel, and a mobile nav bar.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: A React component that displays a movie card with title, year, genre, synopsis, and a 'Watch Now' link styled in a dark/silver aesthetic.
frontend/src/components/MusicPlayer.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports defined.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: A modal panel component that lets users customize the site's background wallpaper and overlay opacity, offering nine texture options with thumbnails.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: A React component that renders a TV show card with title, episode count, genre badge, description, and a styled 'Watch Now' button.
frontend/src/components/SongCard.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports defined.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports defined.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A small clock widget that displays the current time (hours, minutes, seconds) and date, updating every second.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget for managing a list of favorite links, supporting add and remove operations via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A mood picker widget that lets users select and persist a current mood emoji/label, stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: Exports a typed array of anime show data (title, episodes, genre, description, watch URL) spanning classic and modern series.
frontend/src/data/browserGames.ts: Defines and exports a typed list of browser game metadata (id, title, category, description, emoji) for six mini-games.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Chinese drama show data including title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: Defines a Game interface and exports a large array of classic/retro games with metadata (title, category, description, archive.org URL), auto-assigned numeric IDs.
frontend/src/data/generatedMusic.ts: Empty file with no exports or content.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Japanese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Korean drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and streaming URLs (Viki, Netflix, Kocowa).
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of classic/public-domain movies with title, year, genre, synopsis, and archive.org watch URLs, starting from the silent era.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Empty file with no exports or content.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state (messages, loading, error) for an AI assistant named Kitschy, with send and clearHistory callbacks that call an AI service.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovieSearch.ts: Custom hook that fetches movies from TMDB based on a search query and genre filter with debouncing and pagination support. Returns movie list, loading states, error, and a `loadMore` function.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: Hook that manages user personalization settings (background texture and overlay opacity) with localStorage persistence. Provides setters and a helper to resolve texture names to asset URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and removing favorites via a canister actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: Chat UI page featuring a Kitschy AI assistant with message bubbles, a loading indicator, and a textarea input that sends messages via the `useChat` hook.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page that displays a filterable, searchable grid of anime shows using static data, with genre select and search input controls.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: C-Drama browse page that displays Chinese drama shows with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a responsive grid of ShowCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Favorites.tsx: Empty file with no content or implementation.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Games page that lists browser-playable games with search and category filters, opening selected games in a GameModal with mapped React game components.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home/landing page displaying a hero section and navigation cards linking to the Games and Movies sections, plus a decorative image and style tip.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: J-Drama browse page that displays Japanese drama shows with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a responsive grid of ShowCard components.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: K-Drama browse page that displays Korean drama shows with search and genre filter controls, rendering results in a responsive grid of ShowCard components.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Movies page that fetches TMDB movies with infinite scroll, supporting search and genre filtering, and displays each movie in a card with a lazy-loaded trailer link.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Empty file with no content or implementation.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: React page that lets users customize the app's background wallpaper and overlay opacity, offering 9 texture/wallpaper options with thumbnail previews and persisting selections via the usePersonalization hook.
frontend/src/pages/PlaylistDetail.tsx: Empty file — placeholder for a playlist detail page that has been gutted as part of music feature removal.
frontend/src/pages/Playlists.tsx: Empty file — placeholder for the playlists page that has been gutted as part of music feature removal.

frontend/src/services/youtubeService.ts: Empty file — YouTube service removed as part of music feature cleanup.
